Name: Kassym-Jomart Tokayev
School: Moscow State Institute of International Relations
Notes: Anchor row. Already tracked as P001 in the main roster; career is in the main Positions CSV, not repeated here. Note: the main General CSV lists his age as 53; born 1953, he is 73.

Name: Kemel Tokayev
Current_Role: Deceased (writer, editor; a founder of Kazakh detective fiction)
Notes: Born in Kalpe, Taldy-Kurgan uyezd (Karatal area). WWII veteran, wounded in Poland Jan 1945. Graduated Kazakh State University (now KazNU) philology 1948. Brother Kasym Boltayev (1920-1942) killed on the Kalinin Front; father Toka (Tokai) Boltayev. The Kemel Tokayev Charitable Foundation run by his grandchildren is named after him.

Name: Turar Shabarbayeva
Notes: Married Kemel Tokayev in 1952. Worked at the Almaty Pedagogical Institute of Foreign Languages. No maternal-side relatives found in public sources.

Name: Bakyt Tokayev
Notes: Named only in Russian Wikipedia (articles on Tokayev and on Kemel Tokayev) with no details; other profiles (e.g. otyrar.kz) say Tokayev was the only son. Unverified.

Name: Kanat Tokayev
Notes: Named only in Russian Wikipedia with no details; other profiles say Tokayev was the only son. Unverified.

Name: Karlyga Izbastina (née Tokayeva)
Current_Role: Businesswoman; co-founder, Kemel Tokayev Charitable Foundation
Notes: Wife of diplomat Temirtai Izbastin; mother of Dana Medeuova and Kanysh, Mukhamed and Beket Izbastin. iStories (2022) reports a Russian passport and a dissertation at the Russian MFA Diplomatic Academy (may conflate her with sister Karlygash). Bought the former MFA reception house in Almaty for 280m tenge (via Meerbusch LLP) while her brother was Foreign Minister. Her firms later passed to Bagdat Omirzhanova, who is linked to VD Stroy-Inzhiniring, a winner of large state construction tenders (Azattyq, May 2026).

Name: Karlygash Tokayeva
Notes: Candidate of political sciences. Listed only in Russian Wikipedia; some media conflate her with her sister Karlyga (Karlygash) Izbastina.

Name: Temirtai Izbastin
Notes: Full name Temirtai Rymtayevich Izbastin. Graduated Almaty State Medical Institute 1980; law at KazNPU 2008; Diplomatic Academy of the Russian MFA courses 1999; PhD Sofia University 2015. Removed as ambassador after the 2022 constitutional amendments barring the president's close relatives from political posts. Brother: Marat Izbastin.

Name: Nadezhda Tokayeva
School: Moscow State Institute for History and Archives
Notes: Patronymic Davydovna. Married 1980; divorce shown on the presidential site March 2019, formalised 2020. Russian citizen. Birth year given as 1957 in some sources. Suisse Secrets/OCCRP: co-holder with son of a Credit Suisse account opened 1998 while a PEP; iStories/RFE: Moscow and Moscow-region property, since re-registered to the Russian Federation.

Name: Timur Kemel (Timur Tokayev)
Current_Role: Businessman; chairman, Kemel Tokayev Charitable Foundation (last confirmed 2022)
Notes: Only child (with Nadezhda Tokayeva). Changed surname to Kemel / Kemell in 2019. Geneva-based; Public Eye describes him as naturalised Swiss. Educated at Collège du Léman, Webster University Geneva, MGIMO (per iStories) and the Russian MFA Diplomatic Academy (political science dissertation 2009). Reported Geneva-area property (Geneva, Versoix, Saint-Prex) and formerly Moscow apartments. Several companies in his name closed in 2019. No government post.

Name: Yeldana Kemell (née Chalabayeva)
Notes: Daughter of tapestry artist Batima Zaurbekova. Public Eye: a Grand-Saconnex (Geneva) apartment has been in her name since May 2022, a gift from Timur.

Name: Batima Zaurbekova
Notes: Born in Furmanovka (now Moyinkum), Zhambyl Region. Honoured Art Worker of Kazakhstan; State Prize of the Kazakh SSR; Order Otan (presented by Tokayev). Public Eye: paid USD 384,117 for four tapestries for the Kazakh Room at the UN in Geneva. 80th-anniversary exhibition at the Kasteyev Museum, Almaty, 2026.

Name: Dana Medeuova
Current_Role: Deputy of the Kurultai (I convocation); member, Committee on International Affairs, Defence and Security
Notes: Née Izbastina. Candidate (PhD) in political science 2004 (plagiarism allegation reported 2010); docent 2006. Elected on the Adilet party list, Aug 2026; at registration listed as manager of Funny School LLP. Profile briefly vanished from the parliament site on 1 Sep 2026. Business in Kazakhstan, Bulgaria and the Czech Republic. Children: Nurassyl Medeu and Nurai Medeuova.

Name: Kanysh Izbastin
Current_Role: Former First Deputy Chairman, Baiterek (left Jan 2022); current post unknown
School: Moscow State Institute of International Relations
Notes: Full name Kanysh Temirtayevich Izbastin. MGIMO and Central Asian University; PhD economics. Left Baiterek 'at his own request' days after the January 2022 unrest. Wife Botagoz Karbuzova; father-in-law Koza-Korpesh Karbuzov. Three minor daughters (not listed).

Name: Botagoz Karbuzova
Notes: Daughter of Koza-Korpesh Karbuzov. iStories: owned a 136 m² Sunny Isles Beach (Miami) apartment through SSS Chateau Beach.

Name: Koza-Korpesh Karbuzov
Current_Role: General Director, KMG-Security LLP (per Kazinform, Jan 2026)
Notes: Full name Koza-Korpesh Zhaparkhanovich Karbuzov. Major general; Doctor of Law. About 25 years in the prosecutor's office, law enforcement and KNB before customs. Customs tenure is linked in media commentary to the 'Khorgos case'. Not to be confused with Koza-Korpesh Dzhanburchin.

Name: Mukhamed Izbastin
Current_Role: President, Qazaq Cybersport Federation; businessman (TSM Group, 3I Materials)
School: Moscow State Institute of International Relations
Notes: Full name Mukhamed Temirtayevich Izbastin; Timur Kemel's cousin and long-time business partner. MGIMO 2003; candidate thesis at the Russian MFA Diplomatic Academy 2005 (Caspian hydrocarbons). Forbes Kazakhstan 50 most influential businessmen 2022 (#44). Donated 100m tenge to the Qazaqstan Halqyna fund (2022) and 450m tenge for flood relief (2024). Birth year given as 1983 in some sources.

Name: Beket Izbastin
Current_Role: General Director, Chairman of the Management Board
Notes: Full name Beket (Bekzhet) Temirtayevich Izbastin. Degrees in international relations and oil and gas engineering; candidate of economic sciences. Order Kurmet. PSA LLP is the state's authorised body for the North Caspian (Kashagan), Karachaganak and Dunga production-sharing agreements.

Name: Nurassyl Medeu
Current_Role: Founder and 95% owner, Kazakh National Sports University; founder, AI National Research University (QAIRU)
Notes: BSc computer science, Boston University 2020-2024; reportedly starting a master's at Fudan University Sept 2026. Azattyq (Oct 2026): his institutions received >2.4bn tenge in single-source state contracts since 2021 and operate from state-owned facilities (a ~125bn tenge sports complex; the Alem.AI centre).

Name: Nurai Medeuova
Notes: Named only in Russian Wikipedia's article on Dana Medeuova as director of the Sal Seri gallery co-founded by her mother.
